subject: Evening showroom invite — propose two batched windows and waitlist
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@vanguard-analytics.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@helixai.io>, partnerships@dataforge.com, matt+sales@greensight.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evening showroom — two 45-minute windows next Thu?

Hi all,

Thanks for the interest in a compact evening walkthrough of Redwood Inference. We’ve been scheduling a short ‘showroom’ session tailored for engineering/product folks who want to see latency/cost demos + routing/fallback in one go.

Proposal: two batched windows on Thu Nov 18 (PT) — each ~45 minutes with live Q&A. Seats are limited so we’ll cap each window and manage a waitlist.

- Window A: 6:00–6:45pm PT (quick architecture + demo)
- Window B: 7:15–8:00pm PT (deep dive: routing & cost controls)

Please reply with preferred window (A/B) and include any team members who should be on the invite. If neither works, reply and we’ll put you on the waitlist and share a short recording.

Attachments: evening-showroom-agenda-v2.pdf (agenda + quick pre-reads), batched-invite.ics (placeholder)

Internal: Ben / Marissa — can you confirm who will present the routing segment vs cost controls? Also proposing a 15-minute presenter pre-brief 30 minutes before Window A to align on demo timings.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com
